recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. If someone with Jira attachment access later recovers Archive.zip, compare it to the historical 4cf6f3c patch, but current core source has no remaining actionable discrepancy for FHIR-17600.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Clinical Genomics technical correction raised against STU3. The issue asked editors to use the attached QA review archive to check whether earlier QA updates had been applied; Jira records an Auto-approved resolution, related page FHIR-core-many, and a comment saying the issue was applied in commit 4cf6f3c.
initial_application: Commit 4cf6f3c0dad1f3691a36c13ce2b0c09a0cf814b6 is present in repository history with subject "applied #17600 Corrections based on QA report". Its patch corrected non-substantive typo/editorial issues in source/release3/search-parameters.xml and source/sequence/sequence-introduction.xml, source/sequence/sequence-notes.xml, and source/sequence/sequence-spreadsheet.xml.
additional_context: The old source/sequence files were renamed to MolecularSequence in later history, source/release3/search-parameters.xml was removed during UTG cleanup, and the MolecularSequence folder was later deleted. In current source/fhir.ini, molecularsequence is commented out and moleculardefinition is active; source/sequence, source/release3, and source/molecularsequence are absent. The Jira attachment URLs returned HTTP 403 here, but direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting or clarifying FHIR-17600 discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the recorded historical QA corrections were applied and no current build-scoped source retains the corrected old text.

related_jiras.note: Renamed the old Sequence source folder to MolecularSequence shortly after the FHIR-17600 application, explaining part of the later source history.
